rows.text: A set of treasure maps that dynamically track monsters. In the labyrinthine hunting grounds of Planet Minotaur, hunting Minotaurs was once an incredibly popular activity. However, as Minotaurs faced extinction due to environmental degradation, the activity was forcibly suspended two Amber Eras ago. Nevertheless, conservation specialists from the Intelligentsia Guild have implanted tracking chips in every surviving Minotaur and developed a rather reliable population recovery plan. Perhaps in the near future, people will once again be able to shout that classic hunter line in the maze: "Holy cow, there's a bull!"
